lines.zh: 我一步能跨过整片矮灌木。
lines.en: One stride clears a whole low shrub.

lines.zh: 三格高的身子，走过草丛就压平。
lines.en: Three blocks tall; the brush flattens under me.
My steps are quiet. I read the wind first.
My claws furrow the dry earth.
I walk the ridge for the view.
This whole stretch is my territory.

lines.zh: 我侧头听草丛里的动静。
lines.en: I tilt my head to the brush.
I do not hurry. I save my strength.
My tail sweeps a row of ferns down.

lines.zh: 稀树草原上有我喜欢的味道。
lines.en: I like the smell of this savanna.
My hooked claws never retract.

lines.zh: 我绕着猎物可能经过的路走。
lines.en: I walk the ways prey will cross.

lines.zh: 灌木里的小东西先跑了。
lines.en: The small things in the brush run first.
I lower myself as if to spring.
My shadow looks smaller than I am.

lines.zh: 我在河边喝过水，再往前。
lines.en: I drank at the river. Now onward.
I stand, head low, scanning.
A low sound sits in my throat.
My teeth are uneven.
The wind brings blood.
I need not run. I ambush.
This range is mine.
I listen for hooves far off.
My forelimbs are shorter than my hind.
I open my jaws slowly to cool.
My young are in the shade behind.
These dead branches will not stop me.

lines.zh: 血腥味留在我的舌头上。
lines.en: The taste of blood lingers on my tongue.
Something moves in the ferns behind me.
You stand in my range.
You should not have taken this route.
I am smelling you.
You are not a full meal.
Do not run. I can wait.

lines.zh: 这一带有幼崽，所以你不能过去。
lines.en: There are young ones. You do not pass.
The iron on you smells strange.
My throat is rumbling.
My roar shakes the grass.
Blood runs onto my feet.
I shift back, then press in again.
That only makes me worse.
I rub the wound in the grass.
That will leave a scar.
One more and I tear you apart.
Bleeding is nothing new to me.
Blood. Fresh.
That would not fill a tooth.
I smell meat.
Throw it.
I lick the blood off the ground.
That morsel is one bite, gone.
I leave once I have eaten.
Get back. I do not share.

lines.zh: 你撞到的是骨头和肌肉。
lines.en: You hit bone and muscle.
I turn, and you stagger off.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀比你整个人重。
lines.en: My shoulder outweighs you.
Do not walk beside my tail.

lines.zh: 我退开，是为了再扑一次。
lines.en: I pull back only to lunge again.
That taught you distance.
I am guarding what is behind me.
Your steps are too loud.

lines.zh: 这一片只能有一个成年雄。
lines.en: Only one grown male here.
I hold my own range.
This is not the season.
My young need me.
Stay away from the nest.
A low note rolls in my throat.
I turn for the trees.

lines.zh: 这片领地，只留一个成年雄。
lines.en: This territory holds only one adult male.
This I cannot chew.
Meat on the ground. Good.
I dip my head and take it.
Whose was this? Mine.
I do not eat bone.
No meat on this; I toss it aside.
Not enough. Any more?
The bites I leave keep bleeding.
Do not take it.
My eyes fix on your neck.
Running will not help.

lines.zh: 莫里森组的顶级猎手，一步就到。
lines.en: Morrison's top hunter closes in one stride.
My teeth are already bare.
This territory refuses you.
My young are watching from behind.

lines.zh: 我把头压低到你的高度。
lines.en: I drop my head to your level.
It begins now.
My claws scrape the earth.
I lower my body, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 莫里森组的头号猎手，就是我。
lines.en: The Morrison's top hunter is me.
My growl deepens.
You are on my path.
The wind favors me now.
My jaws are open.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，绕到你侧后。
lines.en: I crouch low and circle to your flank.
My jaws close on your shoulder.
My claws open you first.
This one bleeds.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，血就流出来。
lines.en: I bite down and the blood comes.
My teeth shear and tear deeper.
This strike goes for the throat.
One shake of my head tears it.
You are bleeding freely.
I am still pressing down.
My teeth shear and open a gash.
I step out of the ferns.
Morrison's dry soil underfoot.
The wind carries grass.
I rise to my full three blocks.
This is new ground.
I test the air.
I cross the ridge slowly.
Hooves, far away.
I lower my tail.
I roar so the wood knows.
Enough prey here.
I break a dead branch.

lines.zh: 皮毛烧起来，我在地上打滚。
lines.en: My hide burns; I roll in the dirt.
My legs buckle on landing.
In water all my strength is gone.
A spear buries in my flank.
That strange force buckles my legs.
Hungry, I bite anything.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的毛都竖着。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; my hide bristles.

lines.zh: 这里没有猎物，也没有地。
lines.en: No prey here, and no ground.
